verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents a server-side REST API for creating and configuring Rooms and Compositions, with webhook status callbacks. That allows non-interactive, scripted control that could run in automation. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI-specific tooling, or headless participants that can join rooms and publish media without a UI. Missing for 10: documented CLI or headless client mode, CI integration guidance or examples, headless media participants, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use this API to set Room properties such as its name, type, TURN configuration, webhook status callback URL, and the maximum number of Participants.
Configure a `StatusCallback` URL when creating a Room using the REST API, and Twilio will make an HTTP request (webhook) to that URL whenever an event takes place in the Room.
This makes it easier to interact with Twilio's REST API without having to keep track of Twilio's Room SID identifiers.
